title: Software Engineer II
highlights: Led about 60–70% of the frontend for an enterprise AI agent management platform, designed its role-based access model across routing and API authorization, and raised its Lighthouse performance score from 62 to 88.
Architected a micro-frontend LMS with Webpack Module Federation and built its REST APIs with Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL on AWS EC2, serving 10K+ concurrent users at peak.
Built serverless Node.js services on AWS Lambda, API Gateway and DynamoDB, and integrated Stripe recurring billing that cut failed payment follow-ups by 60%.
Set up a shared component library and PR review standards that sped up onboarding and lowered the UI bug rate.
